name: V Nadezhde na Svetloe Buduschee
source:
The story begins with the fact that you move with your mother, sister and brother to another country to your aunt, leaving your dad alone in a complete misunderstanding of what is happening. But it's unlikely that your dad will leave everything as it is, he has good connections, and it's only a matter of time before he finds you and learns the bitter truth.

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/hoping-for-a-brighter-future-v0-2-ep-2-fuuccck.194393/]F95 Zone[/url]]
translation:
故事开始于这样一个事实：你和你的母亲、姐妹和兄弟搬到另一个国家去见你的姨妈，留下你的父亲独自一人，对所发生的事情完全误解。但你爸爸不太可能让一切保持原样，他有很好的人脉，他找到你并了解痛苦的真相只是时间问题。

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/hoping-for-a-brighter-future-v0-2-ep-2-fuuccck.194393/]F95区[/url]]
